pageDescription: Real-time monitoring of network connections against known threat lists.

cloudNotConfigured.title: Kudu Cloud Pro required
cloudNotConfigured.description: Connect this device to Kudu Cloud Pro to receive the current threat blacklist and monitor suspicious network activity.

connectionError.title: Cloud connection needs attention
connectionError.description: This device has a saved Cloud key, but it is no longer authorized. Review the connection and link it again.

planRequired.title: Kudu Cloud Pro required
planRequired.description: Threat monitoring is a Pro feature. Upgrade your Cloud plan to receive the live threat blacklist on this device.

inactive.title: Threat monitor inactive
inactive.description: Cloud is connected, but no threat blacklist is available yet. Check your Pro plan or try again after the Cloud agent reconnects.

allClear.title: All clear
allClear.description: No suspicious connections or DNS entries have been detected. The monitor continues scanning in the background.
